## What changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Rules or schema changed → docs and fixture updated (`docs/data-source.md`, `docs/data-model.md`, `collector/tests/`)
- [ ] A rule change adds a new rule set with `valid_from`; existing rule sets are not edited
- [ ] `make test` passes; screenshots in `web/e2e/screenshots/` reviewed if the UI changed
- [ ] Spec section referenced in the code (`# spec x.y`) where behaviour changed
